refresh: Yearly, around March–April. Find the new 'Collated_Tables_3_12_to_3_15a_YYZZ.ods' on the new year's page, update the URL, file names and vintage, re-run, and re-check knownGaps (suppressed areas change year to year).

caveats: Survey of Personal Incomes: a sample of taxpayers, so local figures are estimates, published rounded to the nearest thousand people / £1m.
Covers taxpayers only. In 2023-24 people whose only income is the state pension are largely not captured.
